Elena: FYI NorthPoint raised a billing variance on Azure Marketplace invoice dated 2026-05-02. They say seats show up twice in the usage file.

Diego: Do we have their invoice id?

Elena: AZ-INV-20260502-9911, account northpoint-prod-21. Their reconciliation team sent CSV showing duplicate 'metered_event' rows for sku np-seat-monthly.

Aisha: Any dollar impact?

Elena: Quick calc from their CSV: ~456 seats duplicated across the month at $10/seat => $4,560.

Diego: Could be our retry dedupe key changed after a schema migration. Can you paste the sample rows?

Elena: Sample from their CSV (sanitized):
```
account,sku,event_ts,quantity,ingestion_id,external_id
northpoint-prod-21,np-seat-monthly,2026-05-02T02:12:01Z,1,0x9b2c,evt-54321
northpoint-prod-21,np-seat-monthly,2026-05-02T02:12:01Z,1,0x9b2c,evt-54321-retry
```

Sam: That external_id suffix looks like our retry handler appended '-retry' but ingestion_id remained the same. The dedupe probably keyed on external_id previously and now keys on ingestion_id, so both rows passed.

billing-bot: New ticket BILL-4621 created for NorthPoint duplicate metered events. Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4621

Priya: For customer satisfaction, can we issue a provisional credit for $4,560 and mark as pending reconciliation?

Aisha: Approve provisional credit $4,560 pending eng audit. GL tags: marketplace_rebates, partner_channel, pending_adjustment.

Diego: I'll add a dedupe guard: treat external_id and ingestion_id pair as unique. Also retro-run dedupe for ingestion window 2026-05-02T00:00:00Z to 2026-05-03T00:00:00Z.

Elena: I'll create credit memo CM-20260502-NP21 and link to BILL-4621. Customers want a memo reference for their ledger.

Sam: Quick command I ran on the aggregator to find collisions:
```
grep "ingestion_id=0x9b2c" /var/log/aggregator/2026-05-02.log | wc -l
# result: 24
```

Aisha: After dedupe script finishes, we'll reconcile and either finalize or reverse the provisional memo. Reversing journal if under-estimate.

Priya: Finance confirms provisional credit path OK. Please ensure memo marked 'pending audit' in billing UI.

Elena: Notifying NorthPoint support now with CM ref and temporary balance update.

Diego: Patching producer to normalize external_id on retries. Will post PR and ETA ~2h.

Elena: Closing loop here 1: created CM, linked ticket, provisional credit applied. Next check 2026-05-02T16:00Z after the dedupe run. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
